objective:
Problem: JSP-000550 (Justin Sun Prize bank, github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards) — "Must two disjoint equal-length intervals of consecutive integers have different least common multiples?"

1. Find the exact original statement (erdosproblems.com page or original Erdős paper). The text above is only a paraphrase. Quote the exact statement with its source.
2. Check the current status (erdosproblems.com, arXiv, recent literature). If already solved, report "solved by X, link" and stop.
3. Otherwise attempt a COMPLETE resolution of the exact statement: proof, disproof or explicit counterexample. Partial progress is not a solution; label it clearly as partial if that is all you have.
4. If resolved, give a full rigorous proof and a Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization of the exact original statement (no sorry, no new axioms).

Output: exact statement + source, status check, outcome (solved / counterexample / partial / no result), full proof, Lean code. Be honest: do not claim a solution you are not sure of.
